ingredients.name: boneless, skinless turkey thighs, cut into 1.5-inch chunks
hot honey
ingredients.note: or regular honey plus a pinch of cayenne for mild heat

steps.title: Whisk the lazy mole sauce
steps.text: In a medium bowl or large measuring cup, whisk together {chicken_broth}, {tomato_sauce}, {peanut_butter}, {cocoa_powder}, {hot_honey}, {coconut_aminos}, {black_garlic_puree}, {chili_powder}, {smoked_paprika}, {ground_cumin}, {granulated_onion}, {ground_cinnamon}, and {mexican_oregano} until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Season and sear the turkey thighs
steps.text: Pat {turkey_thighs} dry and season evenly with {kosher_salt} and {black_pepper}. Heat {avocado_oil} in a large 12-inch HexClad skillet over medium-high heat and sear the turkey pieces for 3 to 4 minutes total, turning once or twice just to get light color on the outside.

steps.title: Simmer the turkey in the sauce
steps.text: Pour the whisked mole sauce directly over the turkey in the HexClad skillet, stirring to scrape up any browned bits. Bring to a gentle simmer, lower the heat to medium-low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until the turkey is tender and registers at least 175 degrees F internally.

steps.title: Thicken and finish
steps.text: Uncover the skillet and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently so the peanut butter and cocoa solids do not stick, until the sauce turns glossy and thick enough to cling heavily to every piece. Garnish with {sesame_seeds} if using and serve immediately.
